content: 1[378Z. Voting rights.-- Save as otherwise provided in sub-sections (1) and (3) of section 378D, every Member shall have one vote and in the case of equality of votes, the Chairman or the person presiding shall have a casting vote except in the case of election of the Chairman.]
footnote: </br><hr style="border-top:1px solid #0778be"/>1. Ins. by Act 29 of 2020, s. 52 (w.e.f. 11-2-2021).</br><hr style="border-top:1px solid #0778be"/>
